'''Yun-Lingni''' was a [[Deity/Legends|deity]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yuuzhan Vong empire|empire]], the empire of an [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="UF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref> lowest of the [[Yun'o]]<ref name="cswe">{{CSWECite|III}}</ref> in their religion's pantheon, the [[True Way]],<ref name="DW">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref> but greatly feared.<ref name="cswe360">{{CSWECite|III|360}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Yun-Lingni was mentioned in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', published in [[2008]].<ref name="cswe360"/>
